notes: 0.3.33：反馈列表加筛选与查询。列表上方一排：未解决 / 已解决 / 全部（各带实时条数，来自 GET 一次拉全量的 open/closed/total 计数，不再靠本地猜），右边一个搜索框，输入即筛——编号、标题、作者、正文（含环境块里的机器名/版本）都参与匹配，清空即恢复。筛选在本地做，切状态和敲键盘都不打接口，不受匿名 60 次/小时影响。灰字实时回显「显示 N / 共 M 条（关键词 xxx）」；当前状态下没有匹配时给出提示而不是空白。列表仍最多读 50 条，更早的给 GitHub 页链接。
notesEn: 0.3.33: filtering and search for the feedback list. A row above the list: Open / Closed / All, each with live counts from the server (open/closed/total computed from one full fetch instead of guessed locally), plus a search box that filters as you type - it matches issue number, title, author and body (including the machine/version inside the environment block), and clearing it restores everything. Filtering is local, so switching state or typing never hits the API and is not affected by the 60 requests/hour anonymous limit. A grey line reports "N of M shown (keyword x)" in real time, and an empty state under the current filter says so instead of going blank. The list still reads at most 50 issues; older ones link to the GitHub page.
